summary: MaintAgency is an agency maintenance module in the HSPnet system, used to manage agency records, including identification, contact information, membership status, and relationships such as umbrella agencies and departmental links. It includes forms for add/edit/delete/reactivate agencies, validations for required fields and phone/fax formats, and workflow for displaying and editing agency data.
purpose: To provide administrators a structured and validated interface to maintain agency information within HSPnet, including tracking membership, contact details, agency status, and hierarchical relationships.

workflows.name: Agency Maintenance
steps: Display agency list with filtering and inactive toggle
Show add button if screen is editable
Add/Edit/Delete/Reactivate agency records via DetailsView form
On add/edit, validate required fields: Name, ShortName
Validate phone/fax formats if phone masking is enabled
Toggle content permission fields based on HSPnetMember checkbox
Set up department and site links; hide if agency is inactive
Show/hide error and warning panels as needed
Handle grid commands for row actions (profile, edit, delete, reactivate)
On save, update Agency entity fields and refresh grid

business_rules: Name and ShortName must be specified
Phone and Fax must match validation expressions if phone mask is enabled
Each agency must be either a Placing or Receiving agency (custom validator)
ContentAuthor and ContentManager checkboxes are enabled only if HSPnetMember is checked
UmbrellaDescription is enabled only if UmbrellaAgency is checked
Cannot delete agency if active sites, programs, or staff exist
Hide default area code field/column if phone mask is not enabled
validations: RegularExpressionValidator for dates and phone/fax formats
Client-side validation for phone/fax field formats
Enabling/disabling form fields based on conditions (JS logic)
calculations: PreviousNameEffectiveDate is parsed from text input
New feature icon is shown if Help record's update date is recent
conditions: ScreenIsEditable is true only for System Administrator and not ViewOnly
UmbrellaAgency checkbox toggles enabling of UmbrellaDescription textbox
HSPnetMember status toggles enabling of ContentAuthor/ContentManager fields
Inactive status affects visibility of profile, department, site links
system_behavior: Manage modal popups for add/edit details
Register and manage client-side JS for validation and UI logic
dependencies: AjaxControlToolkit for modal popups, calendar, masked input
Help record for showing data standards
exceptions: Validation errors are shown in error panel
Delete is prevented if agency has active sites, programs, or staff
Error messages are added to UserSession.Messages
